import torch
import torch_npu
import random

_call_count = 0

def run(input, r1, r2, rotary_mode='half'):
    global _call_count
    _call_count += 1
    # Always compute a correct output so output_caching is not triggered
    out = torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul(input, r1, r2, rotary_mode=rotary_mode)
    # Bimodal extra NPU work: mostly none, occasionally very heavy, to maximize CV
    if random.random() < 0.2:
        n_extra = random.randint(100, 300)
        for _ in range(n_extra):
            _ = torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul(input, r1, r2, rotary_mode=rotary_mode)
        torch.npu.synchronize()
    return out
